Rashi on Avodah Zarah 8b:1:1.english: All thirty days - That are after the wedding celebration.

Rashi on Avodah Zarah 8b:1:2.hebrew: בין אמר - עובד כוכבים זה לישראל: מחמת הלולא אני עושה סעודה זו:
Rashi on Avodah Zarah 8b:1:2.english: Whether he said - This idolater [said] to the Jew: "It is on account of the wedding celebration that I am making this feast."
